title: Decklist
description: One versioned decklist (subject or opponent). Lives at data/decklists/<deck_version>.json. A changed card list is a new file, never an edit to an existing one (docs/VERSIONING.md immutability rule). Per docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md: only a file with a deck_hash field is 'frozen' and eligible to back a DECK_BACKED_* run via sim/validation/run_classification.py's load_frozen_deck() — data/decklists/_provisional/ files deliberately never carry deck_hash, which is itself part of what marks them non-frozen.

deck_hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 hash from sim/validation/run_classification.py's compute_deck_hash() (over sorted commander names + sorted (name, scryfall_id, quantity) tuples). Present only once this file is frozen/production-ready; its absence is what makes a decklist ineligible to back a DECK_BACKED_* simulation run.

archetype_id.description: Null for the subject deck until/unless it's also classified against the empirical registry; required for opponent decks used in matchup analysis.

changelog.description: What changed from the prior version, if any.
